verdicts.reason: Both move the '30-DAY CHALLENGE' eyebrow below the headline, which breaks the original reading order, and both run the dark panel flush to the side edges with no margin. A pushes the phone almost against the top edge, so very little of the brand mosaic shows, and leaves a dead gap between the eyebrow and the CTA. B shows more mosaic and has a stronger CTA, but its phone slightly overlaps the panel top, the CTA and legal text run close to the side edges, and the legal line breaks awkwardly at 'the app any time'.
